<a2ui>
intro = heading("Vocabulary Flashcards")

progress = progress_bar(0, "Cards reviewed", "#4f46e5", true, "0 of 10 cards reviewed")

deck = flashcard_deck(
  cards=[
    {front: "Ephemeral", back: "Lasting for a very short time"},
    {front: "Lucid", back: "Expressed clearly; easy to understand"},
    {front: "Ubiquitous", back: "Present or found everywhere"},
    {front: "Meticulous", back: "Showing great attention to detail"},
    {front: "Candid", back: "Truthful and straightforward"},
    {front: "Resilient", back: "Able to recover quickly from difficulties"},
    {front: "Ambiguous", back: "Open to more than one interpretation"},
    {front: "Pragmatic", back: "Dealing with things sensibly and realistically"},
    {front: "Eloquent", back: "Fluent and persuasive in speech or writing"},
    {front: "Tenacious", back: "Holding firmly to a goal; persistent"}
  ],
  accent="#4f46e5",
  label_front="WORD",
  label_back="DEFINITION"
)

root = columns(
  cols=2,
  gap="2rem",
  align="top",
  items=[
    {blocks: [intro, progress]},
    {blocks: [deck]}
  ]
)
</a2ui>

The deck holds ten word/definition cards, flipped by clicking. The progress bar is set to 0 of 10 because its `value` is a static property and can't be bound to live review state, so it won't advance as cards are flipped unless the host updates it.
